# GRID ETF
## About
**The fund aims** to track the performance of companies developing infrastructure for the **modern energy system**: electric grids, transformers, substations, transmission and distribution equipment, load management systems, smart grid solutions, energy management and related software.

**Launched in 2009**, GRID is now one of the largest thematic ETFs linked to grid modernization and energy infrastructure.

## Index composition
_Eaton, Schneider Electric, ABB, Hubbell, nVent Electric_

_Quanta Services, MYR Group, MasTec, Primoris Services_

_National Grid, E.ON, Terna, Hydro One, Red Electrica_

## How the structure works
GRID is among the largest thematic ETFs focused on energy infrastructure, grid modernization and smart energy systems.

## Frequently Asked Questions about GRID ETF (FAQ)
### 5. Which companies are included in the fund?
- Leading manufacturers of electrical equipment: Eaton, Schneider Electric, ABB, Hubbell, nVent Electric
